create_getup_env: create a Getup environment for Spot fall recovery with default or custom config
run_getup_reset: run the Getup environment reset method with a JAX random key to initialize simulation state
run_getup_step: run the Getup environment step method with actions to advance simulation and compute rewards
get_getup_obs: get observations from the Getup environment including noisy gyro, gravity, and joint angles
get_getup_reward: get reward components from the Getup environment including orientation, posture, and torque costs
